name: Exp_Candles_Smoothed
summary: This EA trades trend reversals detected by the Candles_Smoothed custom indicator, which applies configurable smoothing algorithms to candlestick data. It opens buy positions on bullish trend transitions and sell positions on bearish trend transitions, with optional position closing on opposite signals and configurable money management based on a percentage of margin.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Candles_Smoothed自定义指标检测的趋势反转进行交易，该指标对K线数据应用可配置的平滑算法。在趋势由空转多时开多仓，趋势由多转空时开空仓，支持反向信号平仓及基于保证金比例的资金管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Candles_Smoothed指标对K线数据进行平滑处理后，检测趋势方向的转换作为交易信号。入场条件：当指标缓冲区4的值从0变为1时产生做多信号（BUY_Open），从1变为0时产生做空信号（SELL_Open），这代表趋势方向发生了反转。出场条件：支持反向信号平仓（BUY_Close/SELL_Close），即在趋势再次反转时平掉原有仓位；同时使用固定点数的止损（StopLoss_=1000点）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000点）。仓位管理采用基于保证金比例的资金管理方式，MM参数默认0.1表示使用10%的可用保证金来计算开仓手数。EA支持10种平滑方法（SMA、EMA、SMMA、LWMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA），通过MA_SMethod参数选择。信号仅在 新K线 时计算，避免逐tick重复计算，SignalBar参数控制使用哪根K线的信号值。EA还包含额外的平仓逻辑：当同时允许同方向开仓和平仓时，如果前一K线指标值不在对应趋势方向，也会触发平仓信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the Candles_Smoothed indicator which applies configurable smoothing algorithms to candlestick data, then detects trend direction changes as trading signals. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 transitions from 0 to 1, a buy signal (BUY_Open) is generated; when it transitions from 1 to 0, a sell signal (SELL_Open) is generated, representing a trend reversal. Exit conditions: supports opposite-signal closing (BUY_Close/SELL_Close), meaning existing positions are closed when the trend reverses again; additionally, fixed stop-loss (StopLoss_=1000 points) and take-profit (TakeProfit_=2000 points) are applied. Position sizing uses margin-percentage-based money management, where the MM parameter defaults to 0.1, meaning 10% of available margin is used to calculate lot size. The EA supports 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) selectable via the MA_SMethod parameter. Signals are only calculated on new bars to avoid redundant per-tick computation, with the SignalBar parameter controlling which bar's signal value is used. Additional closing logic exists: when both opening and closing in the same direction are enabled, if the previous bar's indicator value is not in the corresponding trend direction, a close signal is also triggered.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 保证金使用比例，用于计算开仓手数
parameters.description_en: Margin usage ratio for lot size calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的K线索引（0=当前K线）

pros: 支持10种平滑算法，灵活性高，可适应不同市场环境
包含止损止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制
新K线才计算信号，避免逐tick重复交易，减少资源消耗
开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，交易逻辑灵活可配
使用保证金比例进行资金管理，比固定手数更合理
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms offering high flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings providing basic risk control
Signals only calculated on new bars, avoiding per-tick redundant computation and reducing resource usage
Opening and closing can be independently toggled, making trading logic flexibly configurable
Uses margin-percentage-based money management, which is more rational than fixed lot sizing
cons: 依赖自定义指标Candles_Smoothed，缺少该指标时EA无法运行，且指标逻辑不透明
止损止盈使用固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（如ATR），在不同品种上可能不适用
没有扩展点差过滤，在高滑点环境下可能频繁成交失败
MM=0.1意味着10%保证金，杠杆较高时可能导致过度开仓
代码中注释为乱码（编码问题），影响可读性和维护性
cons_en: Depends on the custom Candles_Smoothed indicator which must be present; indicator logic is opaque
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed points without considering market volatility (e.g., ATR), may not suit all instruments
No spread filter; trades may fail frequently in high-spread environments
MM=0.1 means 10% margin usage, which can lead to over-leveraging with high leverage accounts
Code comments are garbled (encoding issue), harming readability and maintainability
improvements: 添加ATR动态止损止盈功能，使风险控制适应市场波动性
增加点差过滤和最大滑点检查，避免在高成本环境下开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to make risk control adaptive to market volatility
Add spread filter and maximum slippage check to avoid opening positions in high-cost environments

risk_points: 保证金比例资金管理在高杠杆下可能导致单笔风险过大
固定点数止损止盈未考虑不同品种的波动特性
缺少持仓检查，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Margin-percentage money management can lead to excessive per-trade risk under high leverage
Fixed-point stop-loss/take-profit does not account for varying volatility across instruments
No existing position check before opening new positions, risk of duplicate entries on same signal
